corrects: light0600_ops.json daemon counts only; original report and receipts retained
cause: Initial process pattern anchored the interpreter as .venv/bin/python3, so it missed .venv/bin/python processes. Its reported missing PID files came from paths guessed under logs/ instead of importing each script's configured PID_PATH. The false down finding is superseded by this correction.
process_validation: Read /proc/<pid>/cmdline and start time for each process; accepted both .venv/bin/python and .venv/bin/python3. No process was restarted.
pid_path_handling: Configured PID_PATH values were imported and compared against expected process PIDs; path strings and file contents were not emitted. No private credential paths were printed.
